cards.title: Sportsmanship
cards.text: Playing fair, respecting rivals and accepting results gracefully is sportsmanship.

cards.title: Discipline
cards.text: Regular practice, sleep and healthy habits build discipline, which helps in studies too.

cards.title: Teamwork
cards.text: In team games everyone’s role matters. Winning together beats shining alone.

cards.title: Handling defeat
cards.text: Losing teaches resilience. Learn, adjust and try again.

cards.title: Leadership
cards.text: Captains lead by example, listen and support teammates.

cards.title: Physical fitness
cards.text: Sport builds strength, stamina and a healthy heart.

cards.title: Mental toughness
cards.text: Focus, patience and calm under pressure matter as much as muscle.

cards.title: Sport and studies
cards.text: Playing improves focus, mood and time management, helping studies.

cards.title: Doping
cards.text: Doping is using banned drugs for advantage. It is cheating and harms health.

cards.title: Role models
cards.text: Athletes inspire by hard work, honesty and humility.

cards.title: Cheating
cards.text: Cheating wins nothing real. A fair loss is better than a dishonest win.

cards.title: Play for joy
cards.text: Playing for joy keeps sport fun, reduces pressure and builds lifelong habits.

cards.title: Women in sports
cards.text: Women athletes deserve equal respect, pay and facilities.

cards.title: Barriers for girls
cards.text: Lack of facilities, safety fears and old attitudes keep girls out of sport.

qs.q: A barrier for girls in sport is…

cards.title: Inspiring change
cards.text: Visible women champions encourage girls to follow their dreams.

cards.title: Inclusion in sports
cards.text: Para sports and mixed teams show sport belongs to everyone.

cards.title: Equal pay
cards.text: Equal prize money recognises equal effort by men and women.

cards.title: Safe spaces
cards.text: Athletes need safe training spaces free from harassment.

cards.title: Role of schools
cards.text: Schools can offer sport to every child, not just the best players.

cards.title: Fighting stereotypes
cards.text: Saying “girls can’t play” is a stereotype that results prove wrong.

cards.title: Funding
cards.text: Equal funding and coaching create equal chances.

cards.title: Media coverage
cards.text: More coverage of women’s sport grows interest and sponsors.

cards.title: Balancing marriage and sport
cards.text: Support from family and society helps women continue careers in sport.

cards.title: Grassroots
cards.text: Finding and nurturing talent in villages and schools builds champions.

cards.title: Cricket’s popularity
cards.text: Cricket is hugely popular in India, sometimes at the cost of other sports.

cards.title: Olympic sports
cards.text: Medals in athletics, wrestling, shooting and badminton inspire others.

cards.title: Why India wins fewer medals
cards.text: Limited facilities, nutrition, coaching and early talent spotting hold athletes back.

qs.q: A reason for fewer medals is…

cards.title: Infrastructure
cards.text: Good stadiums, coaches and equipment are needed to train champions.

cards.title: Traditional games
cards.text: Kabaddi, kho-kho and wrestling are Indian games that deserve attention.

cards.title: Leagues
cards.text: Professional leagues give players income and exposure.

cards.title: Diet and recovery
cards.text: Athletes need good nutrition and rest to train and recover.

cards.title: Sport as a career
cards.text: Coaching, sports science and management offer careers beyond playing.

cards.title: Fit India
cards.text: Government campaigns encourage everyone to stay active every day.

cards.title: Chess and mind sports
cards.text: Chess builds strategy and patience, and India has produced strong players.

cards.title: Parental support
cards.text: Parents’ encouragement, not pressure, helps young athletes grow.

cards.title: Sports and national pride
cards.text: Sporting victories unite the nation and inspire pride.
